headline: Boston Dynamics has named Rohit Prasad, a former Amazon executive who led its Alexa and AI model work, as its new chief executive.
importance_line: The robot maker, controlled by Hyundai, gets a permanent leader after nearly nine months and signals a push to add advanced AI to its robots; Prasad's plans are stated aims, not results.
summary: The Robot Report reports that Prasad, who spent 12 years at Amazon as head scientist for Alexa and artificial general intelligence, takes over effective 7 Oct 2026 from interim CEO Amanda McMaster, ending nearly nine months without a permanent chief since Robert Playter left in February. Boston Dynamics, which Hyundai took control of in 2021, says the appointment speeds its plan for 'physical AI', meaning robots guided by advanced AI, and Prasad is expected to join the board subject to approval.
